findings.finding: Q3 order intake should be the largest quarter in OHB's history because the nearly EUR 1bn IRIS2 contract was signed on 31 Aug. NuWays sees the backlog at about EUR 4.2bn after 9M, against EUR 3.30bn at H1 and EUR 3.12bn a year earlier, and the EUR 554m Sentinel-3 NG award already opens Q4.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Contract headlines have been sold: the stock fell about 27% in the month after the IRIS2 award and 10% on 2026-11-05, the day after the Sentinel award. The Q1 2026 record backlog (+45%) came with a +3.75% report day.
findings.why_not_priced: Largely priced: the contract values are public, so the backlog figure is implied. If the market had not priced it, the IRIS2 and Sentinel days would have rallied; they sold off instead. What is left is the headline 'record backlog EUR 4bn+' and the book-to-bill in the release.

findings.finding: The covering brokers lean to a beat. NuWays forecasts Q3 EBITDA of EUR 39m against EUR 37m consensus (11.2% margin) on TOP of EUR 347m (+16%). Jefferies (Buy, PT EUR 280) said on 29 Oct it expected the H1 margin trend to continue and OHB to be on track for its targets.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q2 2026: adj. EBITDA +31% with the guide confirmed, and the stock fell 4.63% on 2026-08-06. Q3 2025: +4.72% on 2025-11-13. Q1 2026: +3.75%.
findings.original_quote: Jefferies-Analystin Chloe Lemarie bestätigte gestern die Kaufempfehlung und das Kursziel von 280 Euro für OHB. Mit Blick auf die anstehenden Quartalszahlen erwartete sie eine Fortsetzung der positiven Margentrends aus dem ersten Halbjahr. (Jefferies analyst Chloe Lemarie yesterday reiterated her Buy rating and EUR 280 target for OHB. Looking to the upcoming quarterly figures, she expected the positive margin trends of the first half to continue.)
findings.why_not_priced: Weak edge. It is a broker forecast, not a company number, and it sits in the wire copy. The only gap is that one house is EUR 2m (about 5%) above its own cited consensus. The guide implies H2 growth re-accelerating to about 13% after +9% in Q2, so an in-line Q3 is what the guide already requires.
findings.independence: boerse-express on Jefferies, 2026-10-30: https://www.boerse-express.com/news/articles/ohb-ruestungswerte-schwach-hier-11-weg-957736 (a different broker, same direction).

findings.finding: Q2 reported EBITDA carried EUR 22.4m of one-offs, almost all of it the EUR 21.4m cost of the capital increase, which pushed Q2 EPS to EUR -0.27. Q3 has no such charge and earns interest on the roughly EUR 527m net cash, so reported net profit and EPS should look sharply better than Q2.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No precedent on this name; the Q2 reported loss came with a -4.6% day.
findings.why_not_priced: Mechanical and known to anyone who read Q2. It only matters if headline-reading flow reacts to the reported line, and it does not reach the guide (the guide is on adj. EBITDA).
findings.independence: Q2 KPI table in the company release (EBT -5.9m, EPS -0.27): https://www.eqs-news.com/news/corporate/financial-results-q2-2026-strong-first-half-year-with-profitable-growth-guidance-confirmed-new-partnerships-formed/4b150277-e293-4fbb-88b6-c88b7b99f662_en

findings.finding: The Rocket Factory Augsburg maiden flight was de-stacked in late July. ESA's 23 Sept update still listed hot-fire testing as outstanding, and NuWays flags winter weather at SaxaVord as a risk of slipping into 2027, so the release or call may push the first flight out.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The stock is highly sensitive to launcher news: it rose 6.4% intraday on Isar Aerospace's orbit, on 2026-09-07, although OHB does not build that rocket.
findings.why_not_priced: The risk is flagged but not dated. RFA is accounted for at equity and sits outside the guide (a EUR 145m financial asset in NuWays' valuation), so a slip hits sentiment and not numbers. It is small because the market already knows launch timing is uncertain.

baseline_tension: There is little tension. The lean is -1.07 (the 20d run-up is +21% after a 60% spike and a 20% fade), the findings lean mildly positive, and both are small next to this stock's 6%/day sector-driven volatility.
language_note: German retail and financial press (boerse-express, boerse-global, stock-world) carried the Jefferies 29 Oct and Berenberg 27 Oct reiterations, the shareholder split (Fuchs 60.3%, KKR 19.7%, free float 19.7%) and the 08:00 release time from the Terminübersicht; I found none of these in English sources.

The same German pages documented that the late-October spike and fall had no company trigger ('ein konkreter negativer Unternehmensauslöser für OHB wurde nicht berichtet', i.e. no specific negative company trigger for OHB was reported), which fixed the abs_move scale as sector volatility and not news.
The decisive numbers (the NuWays Q3 preview, the company releases, the lock-up terms) were all in English, so the German pass added context and no unpriced fact.
lessons_applied: 'A number the market has already been told is worth 0': the backlog and order-intake finding was cut from +0.6 to +0.3 because the IRIS2 and Sentinel values are public.

'The move is in the guide' (reiterated median 2.3%): abs_move_pct went from 6.5 to 5.5 because no guide change is in sight. It is held above the base because of this name's 96% realised vol and 3.8-4.7% report-day moves.
'A verified fact is not a predicted reaction' and the Q2 beat being sold (-4.6%): p_up went from 52 to 51, and the broker-lean finding from +0.4 to +0.3 because its bar has a single source.
'A one-off with no path to the guide is a fraction': the absence of the Q2 capital-raise cost was cut from +0.2 to +0.1.
